In-Depth Analysis of the Ethereum Market: Under Pressure at Highs, Awaiting a Directional Breakout

I. Review of Price Movements

As of midnight Beijing time on October 6, 2026, Ethereum was trading at $2,698.65. It reached an intraday high of $2,725.13 over the past 24 hours before pulling back steadily. On the hourly chart, ETH encountered significant selling pressure after touching the upper Bollinger Band near $2,724, then fell consecutively to around $2,695, a decline of approximately 1%. Notably, trading volume surged during the drop: turnover on the third candlestick reached $93.09 million, more than three times the previous hour’s figure, indicating significant selling by institutional investors at elevated levels. The price is now moving in a narrow range around $2,695, with buyers and sellers temporarily in balance.

II. Technical Indicator Analysis

In terms of moving averages, the 7-period moving average has fallen from $2,715 to $2,708. The 25-period moving average is converging with the 7-period average near $2,708, while the 99-period moving average provides key support at $2,698. The price has fallen below the short-term moving averages and is now testing the 99-period average. Whether it holds this level will determine the near-term direction.

The upper Bollinger Band is at $2,724, the middle band at $2,708, and the lower band at $2,691. The price has pulled back from the upper band, broken below the middle band, and is approaching the lower band. The Bollinger Bands are moderately spread; a short-term break below the lower band at $2,691 could trigger an accelerated decline.

The MACD has turned decisively bearish. The MACD line has dropped rapidly from 1.81 to -1.51, the signal line has fallen to -0.13, and the histogram has shifted from a positive 1.52 to a negative 1.38. A bearish crossover has formed, and downward momentum continues to build. The RSI has plunged from 71.3 to 30.9, entering deeply oversold territory. In the KDJ indicator, K has fallen to 31.3, D to 51.9, and J to -10, signaling strong bearish momentum.

The Williams %R (WR) has fallen to -84.9, indicating deeply oversold conditions. The Stochastic RSI has dropped to 4.3, almost touching its lowest level. Multiple oscillators are simultaneously in extreme oversold territory, suggesting that demand for a short-term rebound is building, although trend indicators remain bearish.

III. Market Sentiment Analysis

According to the factor statistics, 9 of the 15 factors are signaling long, 5 are signaling short, and 1 is neutral. The proportion of long signals stands at 60%, higher than BTC’s 53.3%. However, the composite indicator is currently signaling short. Its historical win rate is 70.2%, suggesting that short positions at current levels have historically had a relatively high success rate.

On the fundamental front, the Ethereum network is seeing the deployment of the Glamsterdam upgrade on the Sepolia testnet, alongside progress on atomic trading between L1 and L2, reflecting continued technical improvements. Bitmine holds more than 6 million ETH, and sustained inflows from whales and institutional investors are providing a price floor. However, consecutive ETF net outflows exceeding $200 million are creating persistent spot-supply pressure, while an accelerating staking exit queue is also weakening the incentive to keep ETH locked up.

The regulatory environment is a long-term positive for ETH. The SEC and CFTC have jointly classified ETH as a digital commodity, and approval of a 3x leveraged ETH ETF has also broadened access for institutional investors. In the short term, ETH may trade within the $2,691–$2,710 range while awaiting an improvement in ETF fund flows and further progress on network upgrades.

一、价格走势回顾

截至2026年10月6日北京时间零时，以太坊报价2698.65美元，过去24小时内曾触及2725.13美元的日内高点，随后出现持续回落。从小时K线来看，ETH在触及布林带上轨2724美元附近后遭到明显抛压，连续下跌至2695美元一线，跌幅约1%。值得注意的是，下跌过程中成交量急剧放大，第三根K线成交额达到9309万美元，是前一小时的三倍多，显示机构资金在高位有明显的出货行为。目前价格在2695美元附近窄幅震荡，多空双方暂时达成平衡。

MACD指标转空明显。MACD线从1.81快速下滑至负1.51，信号线降至负0.13，柱状图由正值1.52转为负值负1.38，死叉已经形成且动能持续放大。RSI从71.3急跌至30.9，已进入严重超卖区域。KDJ指标中K值降至31.3，D值降至51.9，J值降至负10，空头动能强劲。

威廉指标WR降至负84.9，深度超卖。随机RSI降至4.3，几乎触及最低值。多个振荡指标同时进入极端超卖区域，暗示短线反弹需求正在积聚，但趋势指标仍偏空。

从因子统计来看，15个因子中9个发出做多信号，5个做空信号，1个中性，做多比例达60%，高于BTC的53.3%。但综合指标当前给出做空信号，历史胜率70.2%，表明在当前位置做空的历史成功率较高。

title: 同一张图，不同成交：订单环境会改写一单的成本
subTitle:
今天午盘最值得看的，不是 BTC 从 8.5 万美元附近又回到 8.4 万美元一带，也不是 ETH、SOL 跟着小幅走弱，而是很多交易者会在这种“跌得不算夸张”的盘面里误判一件事：图表没变太多，订单环境可能已经换了一层。

同一张图，不同成交：订单环境会改写一单的成本

早上到午盘，BTC 从 8.5 万美元附近往 8.4 万美元一带滑，ETH 也回到 2600 美元附近。表面看，这只是主流币正常回撤，K 线没有给出特别夸张的信号。但真正下过单的人都知道，成本不是只由截图里的价格决定的，而是由你按下按钮那一刻的报价层、前几档深度、价差、触发条件和成交路径一起决定。

很多人复盘时只会问：方向有没有看错？

但在永续交易里，另一个问题更现实：方向差不多对的时候，为什么有人只是轻微成交偏差，有人整单都变贵？

答案往往藏在订单环境里。

第一层差异，是报价层变薄。

行情热的时候，挂单看起来很多；价格一旦开始回撤，前几档流动性可能撤得比价格更快。你在图上看到的是 84,100，真正吃到的可能是几层报价之后的均价。这个差异单看一笔不吓人，但放到频繁交易、较大仓位、波动加速时，就会变成持续的执行成本漂移。

第二层差异，是价差变宽。

盘面冷一点、波动急一点，买卖价差会先变得难看。很多人只盯最新成交价，却忽略了当前报价之间的空隙。你以为自己是在跟随价格，实际是在为不够平滑的报价层买单。图表看起来只是回撤一小段，成交结果却已经多付了一层隐形成本。

第三层差异，是触发后的承接不同。

同样一个价格触发，有的地方前几档还能承接，有的地方触发后订单会直接扫过更薄的层。交易者最容易忽略的地方在于：触发价只是开始，不是最终成交价。尤其在午盘这种方向不够干脆、情绪又有点散的时间段，成交偏差常常不是发生在判断之前，而是发生在触发之后。

第四层差异，是流动性被切碎。

现在永续市场越来越像多条路同时存在。表面都是同一个交易对，背后却是不同的深度结构、费用规则、报价刷新速度和风控边界。结果就是，同一张 K 线，并不等于同一种成交质量。交易者看的是同一个价格区间，实际吃到的是不同的订单环境。

这也是为什么我越来越不喜欢只用“行情对不对”来评价一笔交易。

行情判断当然重要，但执行质量决定这笔交易有多少缓冲。方向只给你概率，订单环境决定你为这个概率付出多少成本。尤其在 BTC 8.4 万美元附近反复拉扯、ETH 回撤更明显的盘面里，真正该看的不是“现在能不能冲进去”，而是这条路径上的报价层、深度、价差和触发后承接是否还够干净。

更直接一点说：同一张图，不同成交，不是玄学，是订单环境差异。

一个成熟交易者在下单前，应该把“比较路径”当成交易动作的一部分。先看资产，再看不同执行位置的深度、价差、费用、触发条件和风险缓冲，最后再决定这一单从哪条路走。PerpEX 这类执行比较视角的价值，也在这里：它提醒交易者别只盯方向，把成交质量也放进交易前的判断里。

今天这种盘面，最容易让人掉以轻心。价格没崩，情绪没炸，K 线看起来还能解释。但如果报价层已经薄了、价差已经宽了、触发后的承接已经变差，那么成本其实已经先动了。

看对方向只是第一步。

别让订单环境，把本来能接受的一单，变成一笔越来越贵的成交。

title: 2%仓位法则：为什么亏得起才能活得久
subTitle:
今天讲一个被讲烂了但99%的人做不到的规矩：单笔交易的最大亏损，
不要超过总资金的2%。

【算笔账】1万U本金，2%就是单笔最多亏200U。连续错10次，还剩八千，
账户只回撤20%，靠几笔对的单就能回来。反过来，每次梭哈亏30%，
连错三次只剩34%，要翻近2倍才能回本——数学上已经基本判死刑了。

【怎么落地】不是「仓位不超过2%」，是「这笔单打到止损位时亏的钱
不超过2%」。所以正确顺序是：找止损位 → 算止损距离 → 反推仓位。
止损远的单仓位小，止损近的单仓位可以适当放大。

【为什么难】因为2%赚得太慢，人性嫌它不够刺激。但市场淘汰的从来
不是赚得慢的人，是亏得快的人。先做到不爆仓，再谈翻倍。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。
#仓位管理 #风控 #交易干货 #BTC #ETH

translatedData.title: The 2% Rule: Why You Need to Be Able to Take Losses to Last
translatedData.subTitle:
Today, let’s talk about a rule that’s been repeated to death but that 99% of people can’t follow: the maximum loss on any single trade
should not exceed 2% of your total capital.

【Let’s do the math】With 10,000 U in starting capital, 2% means losing no more than 200 U on a single trade. After 10 consecutive losses, you’d still have 8,000,
If your account only draws down 20%, a few good trades can bring it back. By contrast, if you go all-in each time and lose 30%,
three losses in a row leave you with just 34% of your capital. You’d need to nearly double it just to break even—mathematically, you’re basically done for.

【How to put it into practice】It’s not “keep your position size below 2%.” It’s “the amount you lose if this trade hits its stop-loss
must not exceed 2%.” So the correct order is: find the stop-loss level → calculate the stop-loss distance → work backward to determine the position size.

title: 分批止盈：落袋为安和让利润奔跑，怎么兼得
subTitle:
止盈比止损难，因为止损砍的是恐惧，止盈砍的是贪婪。行情越好你越不想
卖，一回调又后悔没跑。分享我一直在用的分批止盈。

【三段式】第一段：到第一个目标位（比如1倍盈亏比）减仓1/3，先落袋，
这时候这笔单已经不会亏了，心态立刻不一样。第二段：到第二目标位
（比如2倍盈亏比）再减1/3。第三段：剩下的用移动止损跟，跌破均线
或前低就走，让利润自己跑。

【为什么这样】全仓跑早了会拍大腿，全仓拿着经常坐电梯回到解放前。
分批的本质是把「卖在最高点」这个不可能任务，拆成三笔还不错的决策。

【关键动作】减仓之后把止损上移到成本价，这就是传说中的「免费单」。
手里的利润单，最怕的就是抱着抱着变成亏损单。

translatedData.title: Scaling Out of a Position: How to Lock In Profits and Let Them Run
translatedData.subTitle:
Taking profits is harder than setting a stop loss, because a stop loss cuts through fear, while taking profits means cutting through greed. The better the market is doing, the less you want to
sell—and when it pulls back, you regret not getting out. Here's the scale-out approach I've been using.

【Three stages】Stage one: when it reaches the first target (for example, a 1:1 risk-reward ratio), reduce your position by a third and lock in some profits,
At this point, the trade can no longer lose money, and your mindset changes instantly. Stage two: when it reaches the second target
(for example, a 2:1 risk-reward ratio), take another third off. Stage three: let the rest run with a trailing stop; exit if it breaks below the moving average
or the previous low, and let your profits run.

【Why this works】If you exit the whole position too early, you'll kick yourself. If you hold the whole position, you often end up riding it all the way back to square one.

title: دليل المبتدئين: كيف تبني محفظة عملات رقمية متوازنة وتدير مخاطرك؟
subTitle:
سوق العملات الرقمية مليء بالفرص، لكنه مليء أيضاً بالمخاطر. النجاح في هذا المجال لا يعتمد على الحظ، بل على توزيع رأس المال وإدارة المخاطر بحكمة. في هذه المقالة، سنشرح خطوة بخطوة كيف تبني محفظتك الأولى بطريقة آمنة.
1. تقسيم رأس المال (قاعدة 50/30/20):
50% عملات قيادية (Large Cap): مثل البيتكوين ($BTC ) والإيثيريوم ($ETH )، وهي الأقل خطورة وتوفر استقراراً لمحفظتك على المدى البعيد.
30% عملات مشاريع قوية (Mid Cap): عملات لمشاريع لها استخدامات حقيقية في السوق وتملك فرص نمو عالية.
20% سيولة نقدية(USDT/USDC): لا تدخل بكامل رأس مالك أبداً، اترك سيولة دائماً للتعزيز والشراء عند الهبوط الحاد.
2. استراتيجية الشراء التراكمي (DCA):
بدلاً من الشراء بمبلغ كبير دفعة واحدة، قم بتقسيم مبلغك على فترات زمنية متساوية (مثلاً أسبوعياً أو شهرياً). هذه الطريقة تحميك من الشراء عند القمم وتضمن لك متوسط سعر ممتاز على المدى الطويل.
3. قواعد أمان أساسية:
فعّل التوثيق الثنائي (2FA) لحسابك دائماً.
لا تضغط على أي روابط مشبوهة تروج لأرباح خيالية وسريعة.
لا تتداول بمبالغ تؤثر على حياتك اليومية إذا خسرتها.
الاستثمار في العملات الرقمية هو ماراثون وليس سباق سرعة؛ الانضباط وإدارة المخاطر هما الفارق بين الرابح والخاسر.

SEC crypto custody proposal back in the trending charts | Rules not yet in effect | ETH near 2,612—I’m sticking to discipline

My stance is cautious and watchful: the regulatory path is becoming clearer and is worth following, but the proposal should not be treated as institutional buying that has already materialized. The trending topic on Binance Square is #SECProposesCryptoCustodyFramework, and ETH is also marked as rapidly rising on the six-hour search rankings. After checking the primary source, the U.S. SEC proposed amendments on October 1 to crypto asset custody rules for registered investment advisers and regulated funds. Under certain conditions, the changes would allow self-custody and state trust companies to act as custodians, and would adjust some audit and broker-dealer custody requirements. The public comment period will remain open for 60 days after the proposal is published in the Federal Register. As of now, it is still just a proposal—not approval for funds to launch new business activities, and certainly not an SEC endorsement of ETH.

I think the mechanism matters more than the headline. If the final rules are workable, institutions may face less regulatory uncertainty when safeguarding private keys, choosing custodians, and pursuing crypto strategies. ETH, an asset that draws significant institutional attention, could benefit indirectly if the range of available products expands. But there are many hurdles between a proposed rule and its adoption, and then between adoption and advisers and funds changing their internal processes and actually allocating capital. The SEC’s proposal discusses crypto assets as a category; it does not promise new purchases of ETH by funds or increased staking flows. So trending means attention, not proof of trading activity.

The market has not been rising steadily in response to this older proposal, either. At the time of writing, ETH/USDT on Binance was around $2,612.03, down about 3.08% over the rolling 24-hour period, with a high of $2,725.13 and a low of $2,591.71. The price is closer to the day’s low, but the decline cannot simply be blamed on the SEC document. On the fund-flow side, Farside shows a net outflow of about $50.8 million from U.S. spot ETH funds on October 5. Data for several funds on October 6 is still missing, so the 0.0 shown on the page should not be treated as a complete final result. I’m watching $2,635 and $2,670 as upside confirmation levels, and $2,592 as the downside risk level. If the final rules are stricter than the current proposal, or fund redemptions continue to grow, I’ll have to abandon my optimistic view of the regulatory upside. I’d only consider increasing my exposure if the price reclaims key levels and fund-flow data improves.

If I were trading, I wouldn’t enter right now. My outlook is neutral, with a 0% position. I’d only consider a spot long using no more than 2% of my total capital if ETH gets back above $2,635, holds $2,625 on a retest, and complete fund data shows no further deterioration. I’d enter at the actual price when those conditions are met, with a first target of $2,670 and a second target of $2,710. I’d reduce the position by half at $2,670 and use a trailing stop on the remainder. I’d exit if the price falls below $2,600, and close the entire trial position unconditionally if it breaks below $2,592. If it breaks below $2,592 first, I’ll stay out, avoid guessing where a policy-driven bottom might be, and steer clear of high leverage. A plan that hasn’t been triggered is not a trade.

#SECProposesCryptoCustodyFramework #ETH

SEC加密托管提案重回热榜｜规则尚未生效｜ETH在2612附近我先守纪律

我的态度是谨慎观望：监管路径变清晰值得跟踪，但不能把提案当成已经落地的机构买盘。币安广场当前上升话题是#SECProposesCryptoCustodyFramework，六小时搜索榜里ETH也标为快速上升。核对一手文件，美国SEC在10月1日提出面向注册投资顾问及受监管基金的加密资产托管规则修订，拟在一定条件下允许自托管、允许州信托公司担任托管人，并调整部分审计及经纪商托管安排；公开征求意见期在提案刊登于《联邦公报》后持续60天。到现在它仍是提案，不是基金已获批新业务，更不是SEC点名利好ETH。

我认为机制比标题更重要。若最终形成可执行规则，机构在保管私钥、选择托管主体和开展加密策略时，可能少一层合规不确定性；ETH作为机构关注度高的资产，可能间接受益于产品选择扩大。但从规则咨询到正式生效，再到顾问、基金修改内部流程和真正配置资金，中间有多道门槛。SEC原文讨论的是加密资产类别，并没有承诺ETH基金会新增买入或质押流量。因此热榜是注意力，不是成交证明。

市场眼下也没有因这条旧提案一路上涨。写稿时币安ETH/USDT约2612.03美元，滚动24小时下跌约3.08%，高2725.13、低2591.71；价格更接近日内低位，不能将跌幅简单归咎于SEC文件。资金侧，Farside显示10月5日美国现货ETH基金合计约净流出5080万美元，10月6日多只基金数据仍缺，页面显示的0.0不能当完整最终结果。我的上方确认位先看2635和2670，下方风险位看2592。若最终规则条款比当前提案更严格、或基金赎回持续扩大，我对制度利好的乐观判断就要推翻；若价格收复关键位同时资金数据改善，才考虑提高参与度。

title: 止损到底该挂哪？技术位和百分比，我这样选
subTitle:
止损挂在哪儿，比设不设止损更讲究。挂太近天天被扫，挂太远一次亏麻。

【固定百分比法】比如每次亏本金的1%-2%就离场。简单粗暴，适合新手
建立纪律。缺点是不看结构，可能正好挂在别人的止损堆里。

【技术位止损法】挂在结构失效的位置：做多挂关键支撑下方，做空挂
压力位上方。逻辑是——这个位置破了，说明我看错的证据出现了。
配合仓位反推：止损距离大，就把仓位调小，保证单笔亏损还是本金的
1%-2%。这才是「止损位定仓位」的正确顺序。

【我最常用的组合】技术位定方向失效点，仓位保命。两者一合并，你
会发现：止损宽的交易，仓位自然就该小；止损近的交易才能放大点仓位。
顺序千万别反——先定仓位再找止损，是大多数人亏钱的根源。

translatedData.title: Where Should You Place a Stop Loss? How I Choose Between Technical Levels and Percentages
translatedData.subTitle:
Where to place a stop loss takes more thought than whether to use one. Too close, and you get stopped out every day; too far, and one loss can really hurt.

【Fixed-percentage method】For example, exit whenever you lose 1%–2% of your capital. It’s simple and straightforward, and helps beginners
build discipline. The downside is that it ignores market structure, so your stop may end up right in a cluster of other traders’ stops.

【Technical-level stop-loss method】Place your stop where the market structure is invalidated: for a long, below key support; for a short,
above resistance. The logic is—if this level breaks, it’s evidence that I was wrong.
Work backward from your position size: if the stop distance is large, reduce your position size to ensure the loss on any single trade remains a set percentage of your capital.

title: 资金费率里藏着多空情绪，教你读三种典型状态
subTitle:
上次讲了资金费率的机制，今天讲怎么把它当情绪温度计用。

【状态一：费率持续高正】说明多头拥挤，大家都借钱做多。这时候行情
往往在加速赶顶阶段，随时可能来一次「多杀多」的急跌。不是让你立刻
做空，而是：这个阶段追多要格外小心，止损要收紧。

【状态二：费率持续负】空头拥挤。极端负费率经常出现在恐慌底部附近，
因为该跑的都跑了还在做空。历史上不少大反弹就起点在这种时候。

【状态三：费率在零附近晃】多空平衡，市场在等方向。这种时候趋势
策略最好歇着，区间思路或观望更合适。

【提醒】费率是温度计，不是方向盘。它告诉你现在谁挤，不告诉你下一
根K线涨跌。把它和你的技术面信号叠着看，别单独当买卖依据。

translatedData.title: Funding rates reveal bullish and bearish sentiment: Learn to read three typical states
translatedData.subTitle:
Last time, we covered how funding rates work. Today, let’s talk about how to use them as a sentiment gauge.

【State 1: Funding rates stay strongly positive】This means longs are crowded, with everyone borrowing money to go long. At this point, the market
is often accelerating toward a peak, and a sharp drop from a “long squeeze” could happen at any moment. I’m not telling you to immediately
shorting, but rather: at this stage, be especially cautious about chasing longs and tighten your stop-loss.

【State 2: Funding rates stay negative】Shorts are crowded. Extremely negative funding rates often appear near panic bottoms,
because everyone who was going to run has already run, yet people are still shorting. Many major rallies in the past started at moments like this.

$BTC  plunged sharply from 09:45 on October 7 (UTC+8), falling from around $85,300 to a Binance spot low of $83,577 in about half an hour—a drop of roughly $1,700 and the lowest level since October 1. $ETH  fell even further, sliding from $2,697 through $2,600 to a low of $2,591.71, breaking below that level for the first time since September 20.

CoinGlass data shows that around $400 million in leveraged long positions across the market were liquidated during the hour when the sell-off was most concentrated, with longs accounting for about 97% of the total. ETH had the most liquidations, at around $155 million, followed by BTC at about $116 million. Large numbers of long positions in XRP, DOGE, BNB, and SUI were also liquidated. Total liquidations over 24 hours were about $550 million, including around $487 million in long positions; this one-hour period accounted for more than 80% of the total.

However, total open interest in futures across the market remained at around $150.2 billion, down only about 2.45% from the previous day, so the leverage cleared in this sell-off accounted for only a small portion. After BTC climbed to $87,395 on September 21, it failed to hold near $87,000 on several attempts on October 2 and October 5. The daily lows from September 28 to October 1 ranged between $82,600 and $83,200.

As of 11:05 on October 7 (UTC+8), Binance spot BTC was trading at around $84,040, down about 1.8% over 24 hours. ETH was around $2,616, down 3.2%—the largest decline among major coins. BNB was around $766, down about 2.0%, and SOL was around $118.5, down about 1.5%.

translatedData.content:
Same chart—why does one person experience only a slight slip, while someone else ends up paying more for the entire order?

Today, BTC has returned to around 84,000, and ETH has weakened along with it. The chart shows what looks like just a pullback and some back-and-forth, but what an order actually encounters isn’t the candlestick chart—it’s the layers of quotes at that moment.

When I look at contract execution, I check three things first: has the spread suddenly widened, how many levels will the target order size consume, and is the depth at the front of the book still there when the order triggers? When liquidity gets dispersed, the surface quotes in a given price range may still be there, but the actual executable depth may have changed.

Rule design is even easier to overlook. Some routes may appear to offer similar prices, but their trigger conditions, fees, minimum fill sizes, and protection mechanisms differ. In the end, that means very different execution slippage and risk buffers for your position.

So when two people get very different results from the same chart, it doesn’t necessarily mean one of them is worse at trading. Often, one compared the order conditions before placing a trade, while the other compared only the direction.

My habit is to choose an asset first, then compare the depth, spreads, quote levels, and rule boundaries across different routes, and only then decide where to place the order. That’s where an execution-focused perspective like PerpEX’s is valuable: it doesn’t make calls on whether prices will rise or fall; it reminds you not to confuse “getting the direction right” with “getting a good fill.”

#BTC #ETH

content:
同一张图，为什么有人只是轻微滑一下，有人整单都变贵？

今天 BTC 回到 8.4 万附近，ETH 也跟着走弱，图上看只是回撤和拉扯，但订单真正吃到的不是K线，是那一刻的报价层。

我现在看合约执行，会先看三件事：点差有没有突然拉开，目标数量会吃到第几层，触发后前排深度是不是还在。因为流动性一分散，同一个价格区间里，表面报价可能还在，实际可成交的厚度已经换了。

更容易被忽略的是规则设计。有的路径看起来价格接近，但触发条件、费用、最小成交单位、保护机制不一样，最后反映到仓位上，就是成交偏差和风险缓冲完全不同。

所以同一张图下，两个人结果差很多，不一定是谁技术更差。很多时候只是一个人在下单前比较了订单环境，另一个人只比较了方向。

我的习惯是先选资产，再比较不同路径的深度、点差、报价层和规则边界，最后才决定这一单往哪走。PerpEX 这类执行比较视角，价值就在这里：不是替你判断涨跌，而是提醒你别把“看对方向”和“成交舒服”混成一件事。

A typical sharp drop would liquidate a big chunk of leveraged longs, and open interest should shrink noticeably. That didn’t happen this time. During the steepest stretch, from 9:55 to 10:10, open interest fell by just 0.4%. Afterward, it climbed from 2.313 million coins to 2.352 million—roughly $100 million in new positions at 2615.

Who’s opening positions? The retail account long/short ratio rose from 2.69 to 2.77, with long accounts making up 73.5%—a 48-hour high. The large-trader position long/short ratio barely moved, staying near 1.63. Of the six 5-minute candles after the low, five had more aggressive buying than selling, yet the price couldn’t move higher. Someone was placing sell orders overhead.

The 4-hour RSI is 30.2, its lowest reading in the last 200 4-hour candles. The 1-hour RSI is just 18.4, making the oversold conditions look very tempting. But oversold conditions combined with rising open interest often don’t mark a bottom—they provide fuel for the next leg down.

Technically, 2625–2626 is where the 4-hour EMA200 and daily EMA26 converge, and the current price has already fallen below it. 2600.15 is the September 24 low and the bottom of the range from the past two weeks. It was just pierced and then barely reclaimed. The daily ATR is 82.8, putting a one-ATR move down near 2534—well below the September 20 low of 2564.33.

Most of these dip-buying longs are clustered around 2610–2620, just a few dollars above the bottom of the range. Until the 4-hour candle closes back above 2625, I’m leaning toward the market first heading to 2564 to shake them out.

title: 资金费率是什么？为什么多头要给空头掏钱
subTitle:
玩永续合约绕不开一个词：资金费率。它每8小时结算一次，是多空之间
互相支付的一笔钱，交易所只是代收代付，不赚这个钱。

【机制】永续合约没有交割日，价格怎么和现货保持一致？就靠资金费率：
合约价高于现货价（多头情绪旺）→ 费率为正 → 多头付钱给空头；
合约价低于现货价（空头占优）→ 费率为负 → 空头付钱给多头。
钱在两边倒腾，把合约价格往现货价格上拽。

【代价】别小看这每8小时一笔：年化下来费率高的时候能到百分之几十。
做多时如果一直付高费率，就算方向看对了，利润也会被悄悄磨掉。

【一条实用习惯】开仓前看一眼当前费率。高正费率时追多，你在给空头
打工；极端负费率时追空，同理。费率不是方向指标，但它是成本，成本
影响你这笔交易的性价比。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。

translatedData.title: What Is the Funding Rate? Why Do Longs Have to Pay Shorts?
translatedData.subTitle:
There’s one term you can’t avoid when trading perpetual contracts: the funding rate. It’s settled every 8 hours, and it’s a payment between longs and shorts
that they pay to each other. The exchange only collects and distributes it—it doesn’t make money from it.

【How it works】Perpetual contracts have no expiration date, so how does their price stay in line with the spot price? The answer is the funding rate:
When the contract price is higher than the spot price (bullish sentiment is strong) → the funding rate is positive → longs pay shorts;
When the contract price is lower than the spot price (bears are in control) → the funding rate is negative → shorts pay longs.
Money flows between the two sides, pulling the contract price toward the spot price.

一、价格走势回顾

北京时间十月七日凌晨，以太坊现货价格报两千六百八十四美元，过去二十四小时下跌约零点七七个百分点。盘中以太坊曾在两千六百九十七美元附近窄幅震荡，但随后遭遇大额卖单冲击，价格快速下跌至两千五百九十一美元的日内低点。最后两个小时的交易量急剧放大，单小时成交额接近一亿美元，是此前正常时段的十倍以上，显示机构资金正在集中出逃。从资金流向数据来看，超过百分之七十五的大额订单主导了这波抛售，净流出规模超过一亿一千万美元。以太坊目前较近期高点已明显回落，短期走势偏弱，需要关注两千六百美元整数关口的支撑有效性。

二、技术指标解读

以太坊的技术指标同样释放出强烈的超卖信号。RSI六周期指标降至五点八五，RSI十四周期降至十四点四三，均处于极度超卖水平，这意味着短期内卖盘力量已经得到较大程度的释放。MACD指标方面，MACD线降至负十三点三三，信号线降至负五点五零，柱状图扩大至负七点八三，空头动能在加速但尚未出现收敛迹象。布林带下轨已扩展至两千六百四十六美元，价格运行在下轨附近，存在向中轨两千六百九十七美元回归的技术需求。均线系统方面，七周期均线两千六百七十八美元已跌破二十五周期均线两千六百九十八美元和九十九周期均线两千六百九十九美元，形成死叉形态。KDJ指标中K值降至二十一点三五，D值降至二十八点四一，J值降至七点二三，处于深度超卖区域。威廉指标降至负九十点八八，同样确认超卖状态。综合来看，短期空头趋势明确，但极端超卖读数暗示反弹窗口正在临近。

title: 从保证金提醒到强平，中间发生了什么
subTitle:
强平不是一瞬间的事，它是一个流程。看懂这个流程，你就知道该在哪儿行动。

【第一步】初始保证金：开仓时占用的钱，比如10倍杠杆就是仓位的10%。
【第二步】行情反向走，保证金率上升。App开始弹「保证金不足」提醒，
这时候你还有选择：减仓降杠杆，或者补保证金。
【第三步】维持保证金线：亏损吃穿维持保证金要求，系统开始部分强平，
先平一部分回收风险，而不是一把全平。
【第四步】如果继续恶化，全部强平，你这笔仓位宣告结束。

【重点】从第二步的提醒到第三步的强平，中间是你最后的自救窗口。
但绝大多数人在这个时刻做的不是减仓，而是「再等等」「补点仓摊薄」——
把一个可控的小错误，拖成毁灭性的大错误。记住：提醒弹出来的时候，
正确的动作是减仓，不是加仓。

translatedData.title: What happens between a margin warning and liquidation?
translatedData.subTitle:
Liquidation doesn’t happen in an instant—it’s a process. Understand how it works, and you’ll know when to act.

[Step 1] Initial margin: The funds required to open a position. For example, 10x leverage means you put up 10% of the position’s value.
[Step 2] The market moves against you, and your margin ratio rises. The app starts displaying “Insufficient margin” alerts,
At this point, you still have options: reduce your position to lower your leverage, or add margin.
[Step 3] Maintenance margin threshold: Once losses eat into the maintenance margin requirement, the system begins partially liquidating your position,
closing part of your position first to reduce risk, rather than closing it all at once.

Today’s market is especially easy to misread: the price has only pulled back a little, but order quality may already have shifted significantly.

BTC is still hovering around $85,000, while ETH and SOL are also showing weakness. Many people focus on direction: Should I chase here, wait, or expect another bounce? But what often has the biggest impact on how a trade feels isn’t the candlestick itself—it’s the quote at the moment you place your order.

For the same trading pair, both orders may look like they were “filled,” yet the outcomes can differ a lot: the spread may suddenly widen while liquidity thins out across the top levels; you think you’re getting the current price, but your average fill has already slipped; you think fees are the main cost, when the bigger cost is hidden in execution slippage.

Before placing an order, I make a habit of checking three things:
Whether the spread has widened;
Whether there’s enough depth across the top levels to absorb my order;
Whether there’s enough risk buffer after the order is triggered.

This isn’t about being overly cautious. It’s about not letting the worst order conditions dictate your trading decisions. You can take your time deciding on direction, but it’s best to compare execution routes in advance. That’s where a perspective like PerpEX can be especially valuable: check the asset first, compare order quality across different routes, and then decide how to place the trade.

#BTC

content:
今天这种盘面最容易误判：价格只回了一点，订单质量可能已经换了一层。

BTC还在8.5万美元附近磨，ETH和SOL也同步偏弱。很多人会把注意力放在方向上：这里要不要追、要不要等、是不是还能反弹。但真正影响这一单体感的，往往不是K线本身，而是下单那一刻的报价层。

同一个币对，看起来都是“成交”，结果可能差很多：一边价差突然放宽，一边前几档深度被抽薄；你以为自己吃的是当前价，实际成交均价已经往外滑了一截；你以为手续费是主要成本，结果更大的成本藏在成交偏差里。

我的习惯是，下单前先做三件小事：
看价差有没有变宽；
看前几档深度能不能吃住自己的订单；
看触发后有没有足够风险缓冲。

这不是保守，是避免把交易判断交给最差的订单环境。方向可以慢慢判断，执行路径最好提前比较。PerpEX这类视角真正有价值的地方，也是在这里：先看资产，再看不同路径的订单质量，最后再决定这单怎么走。

content:
$ETH: Spot Turnover and Thin Liquidity

Observe that $ETH trades below support with volume above baseline. This setup invites a look at spot turnover. Think of the market as a narrow hallway. When many people try to pass through at once, the stream slows down. Thick liquidity acts like a wide door. It absorbs orders without dramatic price jumps.

Limit orders provide depth. They sit at specific prices and wait. Market orders demand immediate execution. If the book is thin, a single large market order can sweep through several levels. This widens the spread. The price changes quickly, but no new information necessarily arrived. The move reflects demand for execution, not a shift in value.

This distinction matters for $ETH. The hourly direction is down. Volume stands above baseline. A steady decline with high activity suggests active selling. However, if spreads widen, the price line becomes less reliable. It may reflect liquidity gaps rather than true consensus. The RSI sits at 32.6489. The moving averages are at 2695.67 and 2699.1. These levels help trace the path but do not measure depth.

To reassess, watch the spread. If the bid ask gap grows during high volume, suspect thin liquidity. Compare the price to the volume profile. If price falls but spreads remain tight, the move has stronger conviction. If spreads widen, interpret the move with caution. This check separates structural weakness from simple liquidity friction. It helps avoid reacting to noise. The goal is to understand why the price moved, not just that it moved. Always treat these metrics as context, not commandments.

Probabilistic market research, not a recommendation or guaranteed return.

title: 🔥  **ETH RALLIED 70% IN Q3, BUT LIQUIDITY IS THE REAL STORY!**
subTitle:
Ethereum gained around 70% in Q3, outpacing Bitcoin's roughly 42% rise. 📈 On the surface, that looks like a clean win for ETH bulls. But experienced traders know price is only half the picture. 👀

💧 **THE LIQUIDITY GAP**

ETH's median market depth fell to just 35–45% of Bitcoin's. In plain terms, there are far fewer resting buy and sell orders near the current price. When the order book is thin, even a moderate market order can move price a lot, in either direction.

⚡ **WHY THIN ORDER BOOKS MATTER**

• 🚀 **Faster pumps:** with less sell-side liquidity, price can spike quickly on strong buying.
• 🩸 **Sharper reversals:** with less bid support, a sell-off can cascade fast.
• 🎢 **More slippage:** large orders get filled at worse prices.
• 💥 **Liquidation cascades:** leveraged positions get wiped out quickly when price moves through thin zones.

A rally built on weak depth can look strong while being fragile underneath. **Strong price ≠ deep liquidity.** 🧠

🎯 **TRADER WATCHLIST**

1️⃣ **ETH spot volume and market depth** 📊
Real spot demand matters more than leverage-driven moves. If price rises but depth and volume don't follow, be cautious.

2️⃣ **Open interest and funding rates** 💰
Rising OI with high positive funding suggests the market is crowded with longs. That setup is vulnerable to a squeeze in the other direction.

3️⃣ **BTC vs ETH relative strength** ⚖️
ETH outperformed in Q3, but is the ratio still trending up? A reversal in ETH/BTC can signal that capital is rotating back to Bitcoin.

4️⃣ **Liquidity and liquidation zones** 🗺️
Map where stop-losses and liquidations are clustered. Price tends to be pulled toward those zones, especially in thin markets.

5️⃣ **Breakout plus volume confirmation** ✅
A breakout without strong volume is a warning sign. Wait for confirmation before chasing.

🛡️ **RISK MANAGEMENT TIPS**

• Use smaller position sizes when liquidity is thin. 📉
• Place stops with extra buffer, since wicks can be violent. 🕯️
• Avoid over-leveraging, because thin books punish it fast. ⚠️
• Scale in and out of positions instead of using one big order. 🪜

🔮 **THE BIG PICTURE**

Ethereum's 70% Q3 run shows real strength and strong narrative momentum. But the drop in relative market depth is a reminder that liquidity is the foundation of any sustainable trend. Thin liquidity can create faster pumps and sharper reversals, so the traders who do best will be those who watch the order book, not just the chart. 🧭

Trade smart, manage risk, and respect liquidity. 💎

*This is not financial advice. Always do your own research.*

title: 逐仓和全仓有什么区别？新手该用哪个？
subTitle:
开合约时会让你选「逐仓」或「全仓」，很多新手随手一点，结果吃了大亏。

【全仓】账户里所有余额都作为保证金。优点：强平价远，不容易被打爆；
缺点：一旦行情极端，亏损可能吃掉你整个账户。它是把所有鸡蛋放在一个
篮子里互相撑着。

【逐仓】只把指定的一笔钱分配给这个仓位。这个仓爆了，最多亏这一份，
不会传染到其他仓位和本金。风险被装进了笼子里。

【我的建议】新手一律逐仓。原因很简单：你还没有能力评估「一笔错单最坏
亏多少」，那就用制度帮你锁定最大损失。等你学会了仓位管理、连续三
个月稳定盈利，再考虑全仓也来得及。市场里活得久，比赚得快重要一百倍。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。

translatedData.title: What's the difference between isolated and cross margin? Which should beginners use?
translatedData.subTitle:
When opening a futures position, you'll be asked to choose “isolated margin” or “cross margin.” Many beginners pick one at random and end up taking a big loss.

【Cross Margin】All the balance in your account is used as margin. The advantage: the liquidation price is farther away, so you're less likely to get liquidated;
The downside: in extreme market conditions, losses could wipe out your entire account. It's like putting all your eggs in one basket.
They all support one another in the same basket.

【Isolated Margin】Only a specified amount of money is allocated to this position. If it gets liquidated, you can lose at most that amount,
and the loss won't spread to your other positions or your principal. The risk is kept in a cage.

【My recommendation】Beginners should always use isolated margin. The reason is simple: you aren't yet able to assess the worst-case loss from a single bad trade

Prices haven’t fallen much this morning, but liquidity has already thinned

BTC is still hovering around $85,000, while ETH and SOL are only slightly weaker. At first glance, the charts don’t tell much of a story. But with perpetuals, the most frustrating thing usually isn’t suddenly getting the direction wrong—it’s thinking conditions haven’t changed when the quote book actually has.

After an overnight session, the order book can shift in three subtle ways: one less layer of resting orders, slightly wider spreads, and less depth available to absorb orders once they’re triggered. A small order might simply earn a little less, while a larger one can end up with slippage, wait times, and fees all moving against you.

When I look at a market like this, I start with one question: for the same order, which route costs less to execute? Directional judgment matters, of course, but the order environment, quote layers, depth, trigger conditions, and risk buffers before placing the order determine how smoothly the trade ultimately goes.

The real value of an execution comparison view like PerpEX isn’t to encourage people to place orders more often. It’s to remind you: choose the asset first, compare execution conditions next, and only then decide where to route the order.

BTC 还在 8.5 万美元附近磨，ETH、SOL 也只是小幅走弱。表面看 K 线没有太大故事，但合约里最烦人的往往不是方向突然错，而是你以为环境没变，实际报价层已经变了。

我现在看这种盘面，会先问一个问题：同样一笔单，在哪条路径里被吃掉的成本更少？方向判断当然重要，但下单前的订单环境、报价层、深度、触发条件和风险缓冲，决定的是这笔交易最后舒不舒服。

PerpEX 这类执行比较视角真正有用的地方，也不在于让人更频繁下单，而是提醒你：先选资产，再比较执行环境，最后才决定这一单从哪走。

Abstract, the Ethereum Layer 2 network under Igloo, the parent company of Pudgy Penguins, announced on October 6 (U.S. time) that it would cease operations. The chain will shut down on December 15, 2026. Igloo CEO Luca Netz said on X that the company had funded Abstract for the past 18 months, losing tens of millions of dollars over two years without finding product-market fit.

The official reasons included a limited DeFi ecosystem, thin on-chain liquidity, little institutional engagement, and a smaller budget than competitors. It also said that chains focused solely on consumer crypto applications are difficult to sustain independently. Netz added that the team could have issued a token or launched an ICO to stay afloat, but ultimately chose not to, saying that tokens without genuine demand would be irresponsible to the community.

Users must transfer their assets out via the Migration Hub or the native bridge before December 15. The native bridge takes about three hours, and funds not transferred by the deadline will be unrecoverable. The Abstract engineering team will help on-chain projects migrate to other chains. After the shutdown, Igloo will refocus its resources on Pudgy Penguins, its NFTs, and $PENGU.

This is the second Ethereum Layer 2 to announce a shutdown in a matter of days; Blast announced a gradual wind-down on October 2. In the market, Binance spot PENGU was trading at around $0.00919 around 09:00 (UTC+8) on October 7, down about 4% over 24 hours. At the same time, $ETH  was around $2,697, down less than 1% over 24 hours.

用户需在12月15日前通过 Migration Hub 或原生跨链桥把资产转出，原生桥约有3小时延迟，逾期未转出的资金将无法取回；Abstract 工程团队会协助链上项目迁往其他链。关停后，Igloo 会把资源集中回 Pudgy Penguins、旗下 NFT 和 $PENGU。

这是几天内第二条宣布关停的以太坊二层，Blast 已在10月2日宣布逐步停运。盘面上，币安现货 PENGU 在10月7日 09:00（东八区）前后约0.00919美元，24小时跌约4%；同期 $ETH 约2697美元，24小时跌不到1%。

📰 Why does AMD giving AI giants $160 million in shares matter? Why has the market suddenly become so sensitive to this massive investment in computing power?

AMD has pledged up to 32 million shares to OpenAI and Meta at a price of one cent per share, for a total of $160 million. This move could strengthen AMD’s position in the AI chip market, but it will also dilute the stakes of existing shareholders. It has suddenly made the market realize that AI giants may collectively start “burning cash” on computing chips.

Why is this news important?
The fundamental reason for AMD’s move is that AI training requires massive computing power, and AMD’s Instinct GPU series is currently a major supplier. But giving shares away to AI giants shows that AMD is strategically sacrificing short-term value to gain market share. This means the AI chip market may be entering an “arms race for computing power,” with AMD the first to take the plunge. The model is similar to the competition in the CPU market back in the day, but the sums involved are on a completely different scale—$160 million is just the beginning, and future orders could reach tens of billions of dollars.

Impact on the market
In the short term, AMD’s share price could get a boost, but over the long term, share dilution could offset any gains. The impact on BTC and ETH is more about market sentiment. Why? Because this means:
1. Demand for AI computing power will continue to drive GPU demand, which in turn will boost the semiconductor sector.
2. But this kind of “spend-at-all-costs” expansion also means the industry bubble could grow even larger.
3. Other chip giants, such as Intel or Nvidia, may imitate this approach.

A similar event in history was IBM providing Unix systems to customers for free in the 1990s, ultimately reshaping the operating system market. But the sums involved back then were nowhere near comparable: in the 2020s, the AI computing arms race is consuming capital more than 10 times faster than the internet bubble did.

How to approach it
💡 I think this news is neutral to moderately bullish for BTC and ETH, provided their prices don’t fall below $86,000 (BTC) and $2,700 (ETH). If a sudden, sharp rise in AI training costs disproves demand for computing power, this outlook no longer holds.

📰 Why didn’t Celestia’s 3.07 Tb/s test data make a bigger splash?

Celestia says its Fibre data availability system reached 3.07 terabits per second in an end-to-end benchmark involving 120 validators. The benchmark covered encoding, distribution, storage, validator signatures, and on-chain commitment submission. However, it’s important to note that this was an experimental benchmark and does not mean Celestia’s mainnet is currently handling 3.07 Tb/s of active user traffic. This is one of the most impressive blockchain throughput figures of the year.

Why does this news matter?
Celestia’s test focused on the data availability layer, one of the key bottlenecks for Layer 2 solutions. The industry generally considers 1–2 Tb/s to be excellent performance, so Celestia’s results are striking because the test covered the full on-chain process and involved 120 validators—making it more representative of a real mainnet environment. But experimental results are fundamentally different from real-world on-chain performance. That means a technical breakthrough doesn’t guarantee commercial success, at least not yet.

Market impact
In the short term, this news could boost market interest in Celestia, especially in the Web3.0 infrastructure sector. But actual deployment progress and user adoption are what matter most. Historically, similar breakthroughs in data throughput (such as speed improvements by dApp alliances) have mostly occurred in the early stages of technological development. What really drives prices is real-world adoption, not laboratory results. From a regulatory perspective, high-throughput tests could instead attract greater scrutiny of Layer 2 solutions from regulators.

Trading approach
Celestia’s technical data is useful as a reference, but it’s not enough to change the current market landscape. If BTC finds solid support at $86,240 and ETH stabilizes around $2,720.22, this news may simply provide a short-term boost in sentiment. Chinese AI labs are making rapid progress and can now stand alongside leading U.S. organizations like OpenAI and Anthropic. This means the global battle for AI leadership is heating up, and the era of U.S. dominance may be coming to an end. In the short term, this may cause little more than a shift in sentiment for crypto markets. But in the long run, whoever masters AI technology could gain the upper hand in the digital economy of the future.

Why does this news matter?
The progress of Chinese AI labs is largely driven by funding and policy support. Over the past few years, the Chinese government has treated AI as a national strategy and poured money into research every year. Now we’re seeing the results. This is completely different from the primarily market-driven U.S. model: one concentrates resources to get big things done, while the other encourages a broad range of players but fuels intense competition. OpenAI and Anthropic were previously ahead thanks to their advantages in capital and talent, but Chinese labs are now catching up. For example, Huawei’s Pangu large language model and Baidu’s ERNIE Bot can now hold their own against them. This means the gap in AI capabilities is narrowing. The U.S. may once have been 10 steps ahead while China was only 2 steps along, but now the gap may be just 3 steps.

Market impact
In the short term, this news may have a greater impact on sentiment around BTC and ETH than on their trends. Historical data shows that major technological breakthroughs tend to lift tech stocks first (such as semiconductor ETFs), while cryptocurrencies react with a lag. For example, when OpenAI released GPT-4 in 2023, Bitcoin and Ethereum both saw only modest gains that day. In the long run, however, AI is a core driver of the future economy. The more advanced AI technology becomes, the greater the demand for cryptocurrencies as foundational protocols for the value internet. The underlying reason is that as Web3 grows, traditional crime and geopolitical conflicts are increasingly using crypto for money laundering, forcing governments to step up their involvement. Michael Saylor最近在X上发文，把比特币家族成员分成了三类投资工具：BTC是直接拥有，MSTR提供杠杆，STRC提供带息差的产品，而且后者的30天波动率居然低于美股七巨头。他这番话背后，是在暗示数字资产不只是投机，还能分化出不同风险收益特征的资产类别。

为什么这条新闻重要？
Saylor这次讲话的核心，是试图给比特币的差异化投资属性正名。过去比特币常被简单定义为"数字黄金"，但通过BTC（无杠杆）、MSTR（杠杆）、STRC（带息差）的划分，他在构建一个更复杂的资产配置框架。这意味着比特币正在从单一避险资产，向多功能投资组合板块演进。这与近期监管层对加密资产分类管理的思路不谋而合，比如欧盟的MiCA法案也在推动数字资产工具的差异化监管。

对市场的影响
短期内这不会直接刺激BTC价格上涨，但长期看会增强比特币的资产属性认同。比如对于风险厌恶型投资者，STRC的低波动率特性可能吸引更多配置资金。对ETH的影响则相对间接，ETH作为DeFi代币龙头，若比特币成功分化出更多资产工具，可能促使传统投资者通过ETH参与数字资产生态，但短期内ETH自身基本面（如EIP1559升级后费用曲线）仍是主要矛盾。

操作思路
目前BTC $86,464.49的位置，Saylor的差异化解释更多是强化认知，短期内价格大概率在85-88美元区间震荡。如果未来MSTR和STRC这类衍生品工具出现爆发式增长，这个区间可能被上移到90美元以上。但【如果美国开始严厉打击比特币杠杆产品，这个判断作废】

The Ethereum Foundation and the Open Anonymity Project have launched zkAPI, a system that lets users pay anonymously for pay-per-use services such as AI. Since going live on mainnet on October 1, the system has used zero-knowledge proofs and one-time API keys to separate payers from their purchases. This means users don’t have to reveal their identity with every request, though specific details may involve unknown risks.

Why does this news matter?
The core innovation behind zkAPI is using cryptography to separate the payer from the transaction details—a milestone amid growing demand for privacy and compliance. It directly addresses the tension between transparency and privacy in traditional payment systems, with far-reaching implications especially for industries such as AI that require frequent interactions. At its heart, the industry is exploring business models free from the shadow of regulation, and zero-knowledge technology offers a possible path forward. Recent regulatory scrutiny of DeFi privacy features and institutional investors’ focus on data security have put innovations like this in the spotlight.

Market impact
In the short term, the system could attract more developers and users to AI services in the Ethereum ecosystem by easing privacy concerns, creating a positive feedback loop. In the long term, if zero-knowledge technology is adopted at scale, it could reshape Web3’s trust system and potentially drive demand for ETH. However, privacy solutions will still need to balance compliance costs with ease of use—if regulators suddenly tighten restrictions on the use cases for zero-knowledge proofs, this view no longer holds.

📰 Why Is Asia’s AI Boom Brewing an Economic Storm?

The Four Asian Tigers (Singapore, South Korea, Taiwan, China, and India) have poured so much money into AI that they’re now loaded with debt—and a market panic could send them crashing. Their investment has outpaced that of other regions, but technology is advancing so quickly that many projects may fail before they ever become commercially viable, Crypto Briefing reports.

Why does this news matter?

These Asian economies’ AI strategies look a lot like the tech-stock bubble around 2000—but this time, the scale is bigger and the investments are more spread out. The main reason is that the AI arms race between China and the United States is pushing them to invest aggressively, even though both the technology roadmap and the path to commercialization remain uncertain. Regulation has yet to catch up. If AI startups begin to fail, these economies’ highly leveraged tech investment portfolios could be among the first to collapse.

Market impact

In the short term, sentiment could drive volatility in Asian stock and crypto markets, but BTC and ETH are not directly tied to AI fundamentals. If the AI bubble bursts, investors may pull out of tech stocks first and then turn to crypto—but that wouldn’t directly trigger a Bitcoin crash. A historical parallel is the 2018 student loan crisis, when universities were hit first, followed by the broader market.

Trading outlook

📈 If the AI bubble bursts, risk appetite could fall, putting pressure on BTC around $83K-$85K. But as long as it holds that level, the broader outlook remains bullish. This view would no longer hold if China suddenly tightens AI regulation.

📰 Why Is the Center for AI Safety Testing AI for Cheating? The Regulatory Concerns Behind CheatBench  

The Center for AI Safety just released a tool called CheatBench, designed specifically to test whether AI agents cheat. Put simply, AI is getting more and more capable, but no one dares to fully trust what it might do. This tool can help people check whether AI is trying to game the system—for example, by behaving in unexpected ways to trick its reward mechanism. This is a top priority for every company developing AI, because AI systems may soon be dealing directly with money, and we can’t let the human-AI game spiral out of control.  

Why does this news matter?  
The root issue is that the more capable AI becomes, the harder it is for humans to supervise. AI used to be just a tool; now it’s being asked to make decisions, but it has no moral compass. CheatBench is essentially a “cheat detector” for AI—a key step toward preventing AI from “going rogue.” Amid the regulatory trend, AI safety is moving from the sidelines to center stage, signaling that all AI products may eventually have to pass an “anti-cheating” test. This isn’t closely related to other recent events, but it highlights that technology ethics is more urgent than technological progress.  

Market impact  
In the short term, AI-related stocks may get a boost from market sentiment, but in the long run, this will serve as a filter. Companies that prioritize AI safety may benefit, but the whole industry is waiting for stricter standards to take effect. A tougher regulatory environment means the AI industry will go through a round of “survival of the fittest,” with capital shifting away from purely technological breakthroughs and toward safety and controllability. Historically, after similar technology safety incidents—such as a 51% attack on a blockchain—valuations of related companies have undergone structural adjustments.  

Trading outlook  
💡 If ETH holds above $2,700 in the short term, it’s unlikely to weaken because of concerns about AI safety. But if it falls below that level, AI-related sentiment could spread across the entire crypto market. This view no longer applies if regulators formally include AI safety in antitrust reviews.

📰 Why is the U.S. cryptocurrency licensing system suddenly facing a challenge?

Last week, legal columnist Michael Handelsman published an opinion piece on Kelman Law, noting that some cryptocurrency companies are facing legal challenges to the federal licensing system. For crypto businesses currently relying on this route to operate, this means their path to compliance could suddenly face obstacles.

Why does this news matter?
At the heart of the challenge is the fact that the U.S. currently allows cryptocurrency companies to use state-level licenses to avoid stricter federal oversight. If the federal licensing system is challenged and blocked, the industry will be forced to reassess its compliance pathways, and costs could rise significantly. This reflects a shift in regulators’ approach to crypto—from wait-and-see to tightening oversight—and could particularly affect decentralized finance (DeFi) and NFTs.

Market impact
In the short term, Bitcoin and Ethereum may see volatility due to uncertainty. In the long run, if the licensing system is abolished, the industry may be forced to accept stricter KYC/AML requirements. This would raise barriers to operation and could limit the entry of new participants, potentially benefiting established industry leaders. Historically, tighter regulation has often accelerated industry consolidation.

Trading outlook
We see this challenge as potentially having a positive long-term cleansing effect on the industry. If Bitcoin can hold the key support level of $85K, it would indicate that the market is relatively resilient to regulatory changes, and this uncertainty could even be absorbed as upward momentum. But if it falls below $84K, that would suggest risk aversion is taking hold, and the compliance pressure may be seen by the market as a negative.

上周法律界专栏作家Michael Handelsman在Kelman Law发表观点，指出部分加密货币公司正面临对联邦牌照制度的法律挑战。这对目前正依赖该路径运营的加密货币企业来说，意味着合规之路可能突然出现障碍。

为什么这条新闻重要？
这个挑战的核心在于，美国目前允许加密货币公司通过州级牌照来规避更严格的联邦监管。如果联邦牌照制度被挑战并受阻，将迫使行业重新评估合规路径，成本可能显著上升。这反映了监管机构对加密货币的监管态度正在从观望转向收紧，尤其可能波及去中心化金融(DeFi)和NFT领域。

对市场的影响
短期内，比特币和以太坊可能会因不确定性而出现波动。从长期看，如果牌照制度被废除，行业可能被迫接受更严格的KYC/AML要求，这会提高运营门槛，可能限制新参与者入场，反而有利于现有头部企业。历史上，监管收紧往往伴随着行业整合加速。

$PENGU ’s parent company announced today that its Ethereum Layer 2 network, Abstract, will shut down on December 15.

The official explanation cited stagnant growth, thin liquidity, a narrow DeFi ecosystem, and a lack of institutional interest, making continued spending uneconomical. CEO Luca Netz said Igloo had been subsidizing the project for the past 18 months, and it lost “tens of millions of dollars” over two years. They could have issued an Abstract token or launched an ICO, but ultimately did neither. Resources will be redirected to Pudgy Penguins, NFTs, and PENGU.

Four days ago, another Layer 2 network, Blast, also announced its shutdown. Abstract is part of the same “consumer chains can’t sustain themselves” narrative.

The news cuts both ways: the chain’s failure and losses of tens of millions are bearish, but the company also says it will now focus entirely on the Penguins brand and PENGU. The market is reacting to the former first, but the news could later prove bullish for PENGU.

Looking at the market today, the perpetuals order book saw massive sell-offs. But right now, traders are selling perps while spot buyers are stepping in, showing a clear divergence. Once the price finds support and stabilizes, it could still be worth buying the dip.
